wargear.name: Accelerator induction coil
wargear.notes: Any pulse rifle, plasma rifle or ion rifle this model is armed with has Rng 30" and the Beam type.

wargear.name: Adaptive recoil compensator
wargear.notes: Any burst cannon this model is armed with has A 6/8 and the Rapid Fire type.

wargear.name: Bio-fabrication Array
wargear.notes: This model has the Heal (2+, Fire Caste excluding Battlesuits) ability.

wargear.name: Bionics
wargear.notes: This model has the Ignore Damage (7+) ability.

wargear.name: Blacksun generator
wargear.notes: Once per game, when this model is chosen as the target of a ranged attack, before any hit rolls are made this model may activate their blacksun generator. Until the end of the phase, enemy models that target this model or their unit with a ranged attack incur a hit roll penalty of 2. A model cannot benefit from a blacksun generator more than once per game.

wargear.name: Coldstar thrusters
wargear.notes: This model changes their Mv value to 8"/16" and replaces their Jetpack Thrust ability with the Flying ability.

wargear.name: Descent Thrusters
wargear.notes: This model has the Manta Strike (4+) ability.

wargear.name: Destabilised electrokinetic core
wargear.notes: This model’s photon grenades or EMP grenades have AP 1/5 and Dm D2.

wargear.name: Drone controller
wargear.notes: Friendly Drones within 2" of this model may use this model’s BS value instead of their own. Up to two Drones may benefit from this model’s drone controller each round.

wargear.name: Dynamic mirror field
wargear.notes: Enemy models that target this model or their unit incur a hit roll penalty of 1. This penalty is cumulative with other hit roll penalties, such as the penalty conferred by a stealth field.

wargear.name: Fail-safe detonator
wargear.notes: This model has the Explodes! ability. When they are reduced to 0 life, they may choose to automatically explode instead of rolling for it (they cannot choose not to explode).

wargear.name: Fusion blades
wargear.notes: Any fusion blaster this model is armed with has Rng 10"/−, and have A 2 In the Close Quarters Phase.

wargear.name: Grav-inhibitor Field
wargear.notes: When an enemy model or unit charges this model or their unit, after any defensive fire has been resolved, roll a D4: the charging models reduce their Mv value by this amount. If, because of this, the charging models cannot finish their move within 1" of any of the models they declared that they were charging, they must instead move as far as possible towards at least one of those targets.

wargear.name: High-intensity Markerlight
wargear.notes: This model is treated as being armed with a markerlight; however, if they make a successful hit roll when using their markerlight, the target gets two Markerlight tokens instead of 1.

wargear.name: Iridium-enriched armour
wargear.notes: This model improves their armour save by 1.

wargear.name: Macroquantum disruptor
wargear.notes: If this model puts a Markerlight token on a target, then until the end of the phase the target worsens any invulnerable saves they have by a number equal to the number of your Markerlight tokens they have.

wargear.name: Markerlight
wargear.notes:
At the beginning of your turn in the Manoeuvring Phase, this model may attempt to paint an enemy model with their markerlight. Choose a visible enemy model or unit and make a hit roll as if attacking with a ranged weapon with a Rng value of 30": if the hit roll is successful, the target gets a Markerlight token. A model (excluding Machines) that uses their markerlight cannot make ranged attacks in the same phase.
When a friendly Fire Caste model makes a ranged attack against a target model or unit that has any of your Markerlight tokens, re-roll hit rolls of 1 and reduce any hit roll penalty they incur for firing at long range by 2 (to a minimum of 0). If the target has 2 or more Markerlight tokens, the attacking model re-rolls all failed hit rolls instead of hit rolls of 1.
At the end of the phase, all Markerlight tokens are discarded.

wargear.name: Nano-intelligence cluster
wargear.notes: When this model makes a ranged attack with a pulse carbine, pulse rifle or burst cannon, any hit roll of 1 is a successful hit instead of a stray shot.

wargear.name: Networked command node
wargear.notes: While this model is on the battlefield, friendly Fire Caste models may use this model’s Ld value instead of their own, and treat this model as being visible to them for the purpose of the Bonding Knife Ritual ability.

wargear.name: Novasurge reactor
wargear.notes: Once per game, when this model makes a ranged attack, they may activate their novasurge reactor. If they do so, any pulse rifle or plasma rifle used as part of that attack has AP 5 and adds 2 to its Dm value.

wargear.name: Positional Relay
wargear.notes: When a friendly model arrives from reserve using the Deep Strike ability, they add 2 to the roll for this ability if they set up within 6" of this model.

wargear.name: Pulse Accelerator
wargear.notes: Models within 6" of any friendly models with Pulse Accelerators increase the Rng value of their pulse rifles and pulse carbines by 4" and increase the Rng value of their pulse blasters and pulse pistols by 2".

wargear.name: Repair microdrones
wargear.notes: This model has the Regeneration (2+) ability. If the value rolled for this ability is 7+, they regain 2 life instead of 1.

wargear.name: Repulsor impact field
wargear.notes: If an enemy model or unit charges this model, after they have finished their move, roll a D8 for each charging model that is within 1" of this model. On a 6+, that model suffers one AP 0 Dm D2 hit and gets a Stun token.

wargear.name: Resonator warheads
wargear.notes: Any missile pod this model is armed with has the Stun (4+) ability. If a model gets a Stun token as the result of an attack made with a missile pod with resonator warheads, roll a D8 for each model (enemy and friendly) within 2" of them: on a 6+, that model also gets a Stun token.

wargear.name: Seismic destabiliser
wargear.notes: Once per round, when this model would make a ranged attack, they may instead nominate an area terrain feature within 12". Roll a D8 for every model (enemy and friendly) within that area terrain: if the value rolled is equal to or greater than the cover save that terrain provides, that model suffers one AP 2 Dm 2 hit.

wargear.name: Shield Generator
wargear.notes: This model has a 6+ invulnerable save.

wargear.name: Stabilising anchors
wargear.notes: This model incurs a hit roll bonus of 1 for their ranged attacks if they do not move in the same phase.

wargear.name: Stealth Field
wargear.notes: This model has the Stealth (1) ability.

wargear.name: Stealth Field Projector
wargear.notes: Models in the same unit as one or more models with stealth field projectors are treated as being equipped with stealth fields.

wargear.name: Stimulant injector
wargear.notes: Once per game, when this model has been reduced to 0 life and is about to be removed from the battlefield, they instead regain 1+D2 life and are not destroyed.

wargear.name: Structural analyser
wargear.notes: When this model makes a ranged attack, they may nominate one visible enemy model that is Large, a Machine, or that has an armour save of 4+ or better. For the purpose of this attack, this model and their unit incur a critical hit bonus of 1 when targeting the nominated model. If the nominated model is Large (3 or greater), the critical hit bonus for this attack is 2 instead of 1.

wargear.name: Talisman of Arthas Moloch
wargear.notes: When a Psyker (enemy or friendly) manifests a power, if one of the targets of that power is this model or their unit, or if the psyker is within 9″ of this model, the cost to manifest that power is increased by 1✷.

wargear.name: Targeting AI
wargear.notes: This model ignores the hit roll penalty for advancing and attacking with an Assault weapon.

wargear.name: Telemetry beacon
wargear.notes: Once per game, during the Secure Objectives step of the Resolution Phase, if this model is within 3" of an objective, they may activate their telemetry beacon. Place a Telemetry marker next to that objective: for the remainder of the game, the Telemetry marker is treated as a scoring model in your warband that is within 3" of that objective (the marker cannot become non-scoring for any reason).

wargear.name: Thermoneutronic incinerator
wargear.notes: Any flamer this model is armed with has AP 2/3 and Dm 2, and the Critical (7+) type.

wargear.name: Wide spectrum scanner
wargear.notes: When this model, or any visible friendly Fire Caste model within 3″ of them, makes a ranged attack, they ignore the effects of enemy Stealth abilities.

weapons.name: Airbursting Fragmentation Launcher
weapons.notes: Assault, Blast (6), Indirect. When nominating target models for an attack with this weapon, models must be within 4" of the initial model, instead of within 2". Cover saves cannot be made against attacks from this weapon.

weapons.name: Combat Blade
weapons.notes: This weapon can attack with an A value of 3, but these hits cannot be critical.

melee.name: Cyclic Ion Blaster (Overcharge)
melee.notes: Assault, Critical (7+), Overheat (D2). Critical hits are Dm 2+D2.

weapons.name: EMP Grenade
weapons.notes: Grenade, Blast (4), Indirect. Each time this weapon inflicts a successful hit on a Machine, that model must roll on the Malfunction Table.

weapons.name: Fireblade
weapons.notes: This weapon can attack with an A value of 3, but these hits cannot be critical. The bearer, and any friendly model with the Bonding Knife Ritual ability that the bearer is visible to, re-roll all failed morale checks.

weapons.name: Fusion Blaster
weapons.notes: Assault, Beam. If the target is within 5", this weapon has Dm 6. If the target is at long range, this weapon has Dm D4.

melee.name: Ion rifle (overcharge)
melee.notes: Rapid Fire, Critical (7+), Overheat (D2). Critical hits are Dm 2+D2.

weapons.name: Power Gauntlet
weapons.notes: Critical (6+). Attacks with this weapon incur a hit roll penalty of 1.

weapons.name: Pulse Blaster
weapons.notes: Assault. If the target is within 8", this weapon is Dm 1/2. This weapon cannot be fired at long range.

weapons.name: Smart Missile System
weapons.notes: Indirect. Cover saves cannot be made against attacks from this weapon.
